name: FlutterFlow
tagline: The core loop is buildable, but a dependable replacement becomes a real weekend or multi-day project. For FlutterFlow, assemble a mobile interface from a schema and export maintainable Flutter code. The hard boundary is visual editor depth, native builds, integrations, collaboration, and code generation, plus connectors, runtime reliability, and governance.
